subject: Order form: COI, endorsement issuance and broker delegation for ACME
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme-corp.com>
To: rohan.mehta@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Order Form - COI & Additional insured wording

Hi Rohan,

Thanks for the draft order form. A couple of insurance asks from our Procurement and Risk teams before we can sign:

- Certificate of Insurance naming ACME Systems, Inc. and ACME Global Services as additional insureds (primary, non-contributory).
- Minimum limits: Commercial General Liability $2M each occurrence / $4M aggregate; Professional/Errors & Omissions $2M.
- Waiver of subrogation in favor of ACME where permitted.
- If possible, a retroactive date covering the start of the pilot (2026-09-01).

Attached is our template for endorsement/COI wording to speed review (ACME_Insurance_Template.docx). Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide these items and an estimated timing for the COI and endorsement? Also please share broker contact details.

We need this complete before procurement can issue the PO.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Liu
Sr. Contract Manager, Acme Corp

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: broker@everestinsurance.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, sarah.liu@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-10-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form - COI & Additional insured wording

Kimberly / Aditya — looping you in to confirm whether we can agree to ACME's insurance asks for the Order Form for this pilot. Quick summary of asks from Acme:

- Add ACME Systems, Inc. and ACME Global Services as Additional Insured (AI), primary & non-contributory.
- CGL limits at $2M/$4M; E&O $2M; waiver of subrogation; retroactive date 2026-09-01.

Broker (Everest) is on this thread — can you confirm carrier, policy number and whether endorsement issuance with the exact ACME wording is feasible and timing?

Operational constraint: the customer expects a PO within the week; we may need to provide interim COI while endorsement is processed. Please advise recommended minimum we can commit to without escalating to Legal Ops.

Thanks,
Rohan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: rohan.mehta@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-05T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form - COI & Additional insured wording

On Tue, Oct 5, 2026 at 10:05 AM Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com> wrote:
> Kimberly / Aditya — looping you in to confirm whether we can agree to ACME's insurance asks for the Order Form for this pilot.
>
> - Add ACME Systems, Inc. and ACME Global Services as Additional Insured (AI), primary & non-contributory.
> - CGL limits at $2M/$4M; E&O $2M; waiver of subrogation; retroactive date 2026-09-01.

Quick read: most of these items are standard and we can accommodate them with the usual guardrails. Notes for the thread:

- Limits: Our current insurer can meet CGL 2M/4M and E&O 2M. Good to confirm carrier & policy number from broker.
- AI: We can issue a Broad Form Additional Insured endorsement but we should avoid adding contractually unlimited endorsements. Recommend "Additional Insured — CG 20 10 (or company-specific broad wording)" and provide our standard endorsement wording. See attached stub (Endorsement_Wording.txt).
- Primary/non-contributory: acceptable, but we typically request that this apply only to the extent permitted by law and not alter our insurer's rights — standard qualification suggested in endorsement.
- Waiver of subrogation: ok where carrier permits; broker should confirm.
- Retroactive date: if ACME needs 2026-09-01, Legal needs to approve retroactive date earlier than our policy inception. If their ask predates our policy, we'll push back; otherwise we can request an endorsement from carrier (this often takes 3-5 business days).

Action items:
1) Broker provides COI + carrier/policy info + ETA for endorsement.
2) Rohan to share PO timing and whether ACME accepts an interim COI with final endorsement to follow.
3) If the carrier refuses retroactive date, Legal (Aditya) will prepare exception language and Escalate to Legal Ops if necessary.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Everest Insurance <broker@everestinsurance.com>
To: rohan.mehta@redwood.com, sarah.liu@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-10-06T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form - COI & Additional insured wording

Rohan / Sarah — good morning. Attached is an initial COI stub for Redwood (COI_Everest_20261006.pdf) showing the requested limits and ACME listed as an additional insured. The carrier is NorthStar Insurance Co., policy #NS-987654.

Endorsement issuance: NorthStar can issue the AI endorsement and a waiver of subrogation, but endorsements require underwriter sign-off; ETA 3–5 business days from receipt of a formal endorsement request. Retroactive date: the carrier indicates policy retroactive date is 2026-09-01 and will confirm in writing once we submit the request.

We can provide a binder/letter confirming pending endorsement issuance if ACME requires confirmation while formal paperwork is processed. Let me know the name and address to show on the certificate holder and any precise wording for the additional insured entity names.

Thanks,
Priya Desai
Senior Broker, Everest Insurance
broker@everestinsurance.com

Thanks,
Rohan Mehta
